Author: Vivek Varma

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:73466
Court No. - 69
Case :- Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 482 Bnss No. - 3366 of 2025
Applicant :- Faeem Ahmad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Javed Alam,Nasim Uddin
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 1 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Rampur.

2. After arguing the matter at some length, Mr. Javed Alam, learned counsel for the applicant, prays for withdrawal of this application with liberty to the applicant to surrender and apply for regular bail.
3. In view of the above, the application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
4. Sri N.K. Sharma, learned A.G.A. for the State, is present.
